summary: The bounded Go/JSON and numeric contract passes focused review, including 14 unsafe source rejects, six safe controls, and Number/BigInt and slice-nullability boundaries. Amend for the confirmed actual GoScript spare-capacity ABI: N6 still fails form, list, and effect on renderer symbol rejection, and the existing state encoder's full-backing array walk is a separate unverified compatibility risk.

tests.result: exit 0; all five analyze test groups pass, including four fixture packages, unsafe numeric sources, and entry-package global/init rejection

numeric_audit.integer_boundary: Number-backed int/uint accept only safe values within declared Go width; explicit int64/uint64 use BigInt and preserve full width

encoder_shape_probe.result: valid form.State shape accepted; added string/symbol fields rejected; accessor rejected with zero getter calls; plain own-field object without clone accepted by the state encoder

actual_runtime_evidence.observation: A private, non-global Symbol(goscript.spareZero) with an own data function descriptor appears on actual grown GoSlice backing arrays; spare slots may remain holes until the slice grows. The renderer must snapshot only the validated visible window and must not invoke the factory. Ordinary arrays remain strict.

browser_checkpoint.failure: compiled React renderer rejects Node.Attrs.backing for unsupported symbol properties; form/effect fail at mount, list after action 0

evidence.state_encoder_followup: compilercontract/js_encoder.go snapshots the full GoSlice backing with strict ownArray() before taking the visible window; that helper rejects spare symbols and holes. No source edit or growth probe was performed in this review. N2 owns the actual grown-state-slice probe/repair gate.
limits: The analyzer is a conservative validator for the finite approved profile, not general Go soundness proof; two safe numeric patterns remain false rejects.
Imported dependency initialization is not analyzed; the v1 profile assumes trusted fixture dependencies.
The encoder probe checks snapshot shape, not state transition cloning; clone behavior is evidenced separately at the emitted GoScript forwarding boundary.
No production source was changed by this review.
Four-app browser acceptance is not met until renderer and state-encoder GoSlice boundaries are verified against actual grown backing and all four apps pass a fresh integration run.
